I inspected it rather than assuming. `CanonicalPath` is `^(?!/)(?!.*(^|/)\.\.?(/|$))[^\u0000\\]+(?![\s\S])` with `minLength: 1`. Executed matrix:

| value | CanonicalPath |
|---|---|
